summary: Prefill ISO library URL-download name from the URL path basename. API impact: none — same media/download payload; Controller UI only.

guide.reason: create-virtual-machine.md notes the ISO name is filled from the URL filename and remains editable.

api.reason: API impact: none. POST media/download still takes storage_id, name, and url; only the Controller form prefills name.

roadmap.reason: UX convenience only; no milestone change.

state.reason: No new durable state; media records remain host-owned after download.

verification.method: npm --prefix web run test (isoNameFromURL cases in managed.test.mjs). python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree.
